say:1:1322055001:1.text: How does one live in the cemetery?

say:2:1322055002:1.text: This is only a temporary home. We're still weighing our options for where to settle in Whiteridge.
say:2:1322055002:1.source_cn: 这只是临时居所，我们还没决定要在白山哪片地方定居。

say:3:1322055003:1.text: Oh, Shemira, allow me to introduce you to some... acquaintances.
say:3:1322055003:1.source_cn: 哦，雪米拉，我给你介绍几位朋友……

say:4:1322055004:0.source_cn: 你……是你们，你们来做什么？！

say:5:1322055005:0.text: Don't be alarmed, my love. Sit down, and let's have a peaceful conversation. They mean no ill will.
say:5:1322055005:0.source_cn: 吾爱，别激动，坐下来好好聊聊，他们不是什么坏人。

say:6:1322055006:4.text: Lady Shemira, I assure you, none in Whiteridge shall bring harm to Daimon. We merely hope the misunderstandings between you all may be resolved, lest graver consequences arise.
say:6:1322055006:4.source_cn: 雪米拉女士，我向你保证，白山公国不会有任何人伤害戴蒙。...

say:7:1322055007:1.text: Are you truly saying you didn't lure Daimon to Cedartown? And you claim to have no ill intentions toward him...
say:7:1322055007:1.source_cn: 你……你真的没有诱骗戴蒙去雪松镇？对他也没有任何恶意？

choice_prompt:8:1322055007.text: Are you truly saying you didn't lure Daimon to Cedartown? And you claim to have no ill intentions toward him...
choice_prompt:8:1322055007.source_cn: 你……你真的没有诱骗戴蒙去雪松镇？对他也没有任何恶意？

say:9:1322055008:1.text: Then why do I see you with him every time?!
say:9:1322055008:1.source_cn: 那为什么每次都能见到你？！

say:10:1322055012:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, Mother. He's always been kind to me, helped me, and never once hurt me.
say:10:1322055012:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, Mother. He's always been kind to me, helped me, and never once hurt me.
say:10:1322055012:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, Mother. She's always been kind to me, helped me, and never once hurt me.

say:11:1322055013:1.text: You're still young, my sweet boy. Remember, never trust the kindness of strangers.
say:11:1322055013:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，你还小……记住，不要轻信任何一个陌生人的善意。

say:12:1322055014:1.text: Lady Shemira, I'm unsure how to prove myself to you, but I swear on my honor as a knight—Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, not a villain.
say:12:1322055014:1.source_cn: 雪米拉女士，我不知怎样才能得到你的信任，但<style...
say:12:1322055014:1.male: Lady Shemira, I'm unsure how to prove myself to you, but I swear on my honor as a knight—Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, not a villain.
say:12:1322055014:1.female: Lady Shemira, I'm unsure how to prove myself to you, but I swear on my honor as a knight—Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a good person, not a villain.

say:13:1322055015:1.text: Pray, believe us. We bear no ill will toward Daimon. We seek only to dispel this misunderstanding. If you're willing, I shall also introduce you to a few friends, that you may quickly grow accustomed to life in Whiteridge.
say:13:1322055015:1.source_cn: 请你相信我，我们从未对戴蒙有任何恶意，我们只希望解除误...

say:14:1322055016:3.text: My love, in the Duchy of Whiteridge, a knight's honor is the most solemn and binding vow. It's not something taken lightly.
say:14:1322055016:3.source_cn: 吾爱，在白山公国，骑士的荣耀是最认真和严肃的见证。

say:16:1322055018:1.text: They're not bad people. Even if you can't bring yourself to trust them, at least trust me.
say:16:1322055018:1.source_cn: 呵呵……他们不是什么坏人。即便你不愿相信他们，至少你可...

say:17:1322055019:1.text: If you recall, I vowed on my grave, bound by eternal death, that no harm would touch you or Daimon.
say:17:1322055019:1.source_cn: 如果你还记得……我在坟墓前对着永恒的死亡起过誓，不会再...

say:18:1322055020:1.text: Yes... I remember... Tombstones may crumble, and time may fade, but death... death alone will bind us forever.
say:18:1322055020:1.source_cn: 是、是的……我记得……墓碑会损毁，时光也会悄然溜走，但...

say:19:1322055021:1.text: Of course, I believe you. If that's the case... then maybe I can trust their words as well.
say:19:1322055021:1.source_cn: 我当然相信你。既然这样……或许我也可以相信他们说的话。

say:20:1322055022:1.text: Daimon is my son. His safety means more to me than anything else. As long as he's unharmed, I'll apologize, and I hope you can forgive my impulsiveness.
say:20:1322055022:1.source_cn: 戴蒙是我的儿子，对我来说，他的安危比任何事都重要。只要...

choice_prompt:21:1322055022.text: Daimon is my son. His safety means more to me than anything else. As long as he's unharmed, I'll apologize, and I hope you can forgive my impulsiveness.
choice_prompt:21:1322055022.source_cn: 戴蒙是我的儿子，对我来说，他的安危比任何事都重要。只要你们不伤害戴蒙，我愿意向你们道歉，希望你们能原谅我的冲动。

say:22:1322055024:1.text: It seems many Graveborn reside here as well, my love. You'll find a peaceful and comfortable life among them.
say:22:1322055024:1.source_cn: 好了，吾爱……这里也有不少亡灵生活，你会过得自如安宁的。

say:23:1322055025:1.text: Well, my new friends... We plan to settle in Whiteridge, but we'd prefer to avoid too much contact with humans. Are there others of our kind here worth befriending?
say:23:1322055025:1.source_cn: 那么，新朋友们……我们以后想在白山公国定居，但并不希望...

choice_prompt:24:1322055025.text: Well, my new friends... We plan to settle in Whiteridge, but we'd prefer to avoid too much contact with humans. Are there others of our kind here worth befriending?
choice_prompt:24:1322055025.source_cn: 那么，新朋友们……我们以后想在白山公国定居，但并不希望和人类有太多交流，这里有值得结交的我们的同族吗？

say:25:1322055026:0.text: Wow! Do you mean to say Viscount Ludovic's furniture can actually talk? And he lives in a huge manor...?
say:25:1322055026:0.source_cn: 哇，你……你是说，柳博米尔子爵的家具都会说话？还有一座...

say:26:1322055027:0.text: I would love to visit this manor where everything talks. It sounds like a fairy tale.
say:26:1322055027:0.source_cn: 我好想看看家具会说话的庄园……一定很有意思！

say:27:1322055028:0.text: A beautiful lady and her brother who is a mechanical golem? This place is amazing...
say:27:1322055028:0.source_cn: 一位温柔的大姐姐？还有她的机械人偶哥哥？好想见见他们……

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 向他们介绍卡列琳娜和铐兰

say:28:1322055029:0.text: I really want to meet all of them, Magister. Can you take me to meet them next time?
say:28:1322055029:0.male: I really want to meet all of them, Magister. Can you take me to meet them next time?
say:28:1322055029:0.female: I really want to meet all of them, Magister. Can you take me to meet them next time?

say:29:1322055030:0.text: Daimon, I just told you to stay home...
say:29:1322055030:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，刚刚才和你说过，不要到处乱跑……

say:30:1322055031:1.text: *Cough*... But the people that the magister introduced are all Graveborn.
say:30:1322055031:1.male: *Cough*... But the people that the magister introduced are all Graveborn.
say:30:1322055031:1.female: *Cough*... But the people that the magister introduced are all Graveborn.

say:31:1322055032:1.text: Even if they are Graveborn, we're still new to Whiteridge and unfamiliar with the area. Don't go out for now—stay home and keep yourself safe.
say:31:1322055032:1.source_cn: 是亡灵也不行！我们来白山不久，对这里还不熟悉。这段时间...

say:32:1322055033:1.text: Wait until your father and I verify that the people here have no ill intentions. After that, we'll go out together.
say:32:1322055033:1.source_cn: 等我和你爸爸确认这里的人没有恶意，我们再一起出去。

say:35:1322055035:1.text: Overprotective? No, I hate that I couldn't protect him when we were alive. Because of that, he suffered so much pain and hardship.
say:35:1322055035:1.source_cn: 过度保护？不，我只恨自己生前没有能力好好保护他，让他受...

say:37:1322055038:1.text: Pardon my curiosity, but what fate befell you all in those days?
say:37:1322055038:1.source_cn: 恕我好奇，你们当年究竟发生了什么事？

say:38:1322055039:1.text: You know I was a military physician and was not often at home. Daimon has been in poor health since childhood. He stayed at home to recover and rarely played with others.
say:38:1322055039:1.source_cn: 你们知道我是个军医，常年不在家。戴蒙从小身体就很差，总...

say:39:1322055040:1.text: But he did know a few children of his age. But children can, on occasion, be more cruel than their elders...
say:39:1322055040:1.source_cn: 呵呵，戴蒙确实认识过一些同龄人。但即便是孩童，有时也会...

say:40:1322055041:1.text: I should have discovered it sooner! But in those days, I was consumed by family affairs and had little time to tend to Daimon... By the time I learned the truth, he had already endured too much mockery and cruelty.
say:40:1322055041:1.source_cn: 我……我本应早点发现的！但那时候我忙着养家糊口，没有太...

say:41:1322055042:1.text: And so I drove all those children away. Never again shall Daimon lay eyes upon those wretched little curs... Never again shall they torment my son!
say:41:1322055042:1.source_cn: 所以我把那些孩子全都赶走了，我再也不会让戴蒙见到那些可...

say:42:1322055043:1.text: I sewed a doll for Daimon—he adored it and called it Stitchy... As long as he has that doll, he doesn't need other friends.
say:42:1322055043:1.source_cn: 我给戴蒙缝了一个可爱的玩偶，他很喜欢，给它起名叫奇奇…...

choice_prompt:43:1322055043.text: I sewed a doll for Daimon—he adored it and called it Stitchy... As long as he has that doll, he doesn't need other friends.
choice_prompt:43:1322055043.source_cn: 我给戴蒙缝了一个可爱的玩偶，他很喜欢，给它起名叫奇奇……有了那个玩偶，戴蒙就不需要别的朋友了。

say:44:1322055044:1.text: After Niru was sentenced to death, Daimon's illness worsened, and he too left me... Alone, with nothing but loss.
say:44:1322055044:1.source_cn: 后来尼汝他被判了死刑。戴蒙的病，他，他也……留下我……...

say:45:1322055045:1.text: Alone in that house, Daimon's cough still echoed in my ears. When I closed my eyes, Niru was there, pushing open the door... Their memories haunted me.
say:45:1322055045:1.source_cn: 在空无一人的房间里，我还能听到戴蒙的咳嗽声，闭上眼睛就...

say:46:1322055046:1.text: Oh, my love, don't be sad. That's all in the past now.
say:46:1322055046:1.source_cn: 哦，亲爱的，别难过了……那些都过去了，不是吗？

say:47:1322055047:1.text: After being resurrected as a Graveborn, I returned to my hometown and used gravecalling magic to bring Daimon back. And my love... I couldn't leave you behind either.
say:47:1322055047:1.source_cn: 复生成亡灵的我后来回到家乡，用亡灵法术复活了戴蒙，而吾爱……

say:48:1322055048:1.text: I willingly gave up my mortal life and let Niru resurrect me as a Graveborn, just so I could stay with them. I couldn't bear to be apart.
say:48:1322055048:1.source_cn: ……我自愿放弃了生命，让尼汝将我复活成了亡灵。

choice_prompt:49:1322055048.text: I willingly gave up my mortal life and let Niru resurrect me as a Graveborn, just so I could stay with them. I couldn't bear to be apart.
choice_prompt:49:1322055048.source_cn: ……我自愿放弃了生命，让尼汝将我复活成了亡灵。

say:50:1322055049:1.text: Yes, it was so I could be with them forever.

say:51:1322055051:1.text: I don't care about life or death—all I want is for my family to be together. Nothing else matters.
say:51:1322055051:1.source_cn: 我不在乎生或死，我只要一家人团聚。

say:52:1322055052:1.text: After becoming a Graveborn... I can finally see my beloved again and be with Daimon. It's all I've ever wanted.
say:52:1322055052:1.source_cn: 成为亡灵后……我又能看到爱人，又能陪在戴蒙身边了。

say:53:1322055053:1.text: I won't make the same mistake again. I won't let Daimon be bullied, suffer, or let anyone tear our family apart. Never again.
say:53:1322055053:1.source_cn: 所以我不会再重蹈覆辙，不会再让戴蒙被外人欺负，不会再让...

say:54:1322055054:1.text: But have you given thought to Daimon's feelings in all of this?
say:54:1322055054:1.source_cn: 可是……你这样做，有考虑过戴蒙的感受吗？

say:55:1322055055:1.text: Daimon is a good boy. He knows my concerns...
say:55:1322055055:1.source_cn: 戴蒙，他是个好孩子。他知道我的担忧……

say:56:1322055056:1.text: Once his body fully recovers and he's adapted to Whiteridge, I'll let him go out and make friends...
say:56:1322055056:1.source_cn: 只要再一些时间，等他的身体完全康复，等彻底适应了白山公...

say:58:1322055058:1.text: We'll stay by his side, along with his doll... I made a copy of it and brought it to life using gravecalling magic. This golem is now his loyal companion and fiercest protector.
say:58:1322055058:1.source_cn: 我们会陪着他，还有他的玩偶……我用亡灵法术活化了他的玩...

say:59:1322055059:1.text: Your eyes shift to the golem next to you—Stitchy—and you couldn't help but feel compelled to acknowledge Daimon's sole companion.
say:59:1322055059:1.source_cn: 你们将目光挪向放在旁边的玩偶傀儡——奇奇，不禁想向戴蒙...

choice:43:0:1.text: Sounds like you all had a tough time.
choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 听起来你们当年过得很艰难
choice:43:0:1.male: Sounds like you all had a tough time.
choice:43:0:1.female: Sounds like you all had a tough time.

choice:34:0:1.text: Are you being a little overprotective?
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 你对戴蒙会不会有点过度保护
choice:34:0:1.male: Are you being a little overprotective?
choice:34:0:1.female: Are you being a little overprotective?

say:62:1322055036:1.text: You don't realize how weak Daimon's body is. His essence is overwhelmed by his fragile constitution.
say:62:1322055036:1.source_cn: 你们不明白戴蒙的身体有多虚弱，他的精神也因为羸弱的体质...

choice:34:1:2.text: Is health that important to Graveborn?
choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 亡灵还需要保养身体吗？
choice:34:1:2.male: Is health that important to Graveborn?
choice:34:1:2.female: Is health that important to Graveborn?

say:63:1322055037:1.text: The outside world? A cruel place where we were only ever tormented... I-I don't want to remember any of it.
say:63:1322055037:1.source_cn: 外界……呵，外面的人给我们的只有欺辱……我，我不想回忆...

choice:34:2:3.text: Kids should see the outside world.
choice:34:2:3.source_cn: 小孩子应该和外界交流
choice:34:2:3.male: Kids should see the outside world.
choice:34:2:3.female: Kids should see the outside world.

say:64:1322055023:1.text: That mischievous Graveborn? If we meet again, I'll apologize to him. I was a tad impulsive when we met...
say:64:1322055023:1.source_cn: ……那个喜欢玩闹的亡灵？如果有缘再见，我会向他道歉。初...

choice:21:1:2.text: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 下次你得给伊戈尔道歉
choice:21:1:2.male: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.
choice:21:1:2.female: Next time, you should apologize to Igor.

choice:8:0:1.text: You have wronged me, my lady.
choice:8:0:1.male: You have wronged me, my lady.
choice:8:0:1.female: You have wronged me, my lady.

say:65:1322055009:0.text: An oath is just empty words.
say:65:1322055009:0.source_cn: 誓言……呵，誓言太空洞了，不值得相信。

say:66:1322055010:0.text: Is that so, Daimon? Have you turned a deaf ear to my words?
say:66:1322055010:0.source_cn: 戴蒙，是这样吗？你不听我的话了？
